semantics.definition: A system’s arch, as you drew it from the side: a solid white triangle whose top reaches toward the pool, a frame of two posts and a beam from the front, with the block that goes on behind it.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one arch every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Stand once for each system Mero holds, the way into that system.

measure.thickness: how thick its posts and beam are
measure.reach: how far its top reaches toward the pool
measure.distance: how far its back stands from the pool’s middle
